summary: All representable red-box criteria are encoded in the Urgent priority rule with correct thresholds; Hb < 6 is omitted as not representable. The most consequential gaps are the missing shock-likely rule from footnote 1, and malaria rule losing the 3-day fever window and wrongly requiring pallor. MCV-based diagnoses (iron, macrocytic, folate, systemic) are correctly absent as not representable.
